ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a collection of advanced mechanites able to strategically fortify and reinforce the users body in response to the types of damage it commonly sustains.

ResearchProjectDef.label: comms implant
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a set of implanted vibrational speakers and throat mic allowing for short range remote communication between users. Variants of this implant are commonly found among the civilian and military populations of innumerable worlds of varying tech levels.
This implant allows users to socially interact with each other from anywhere on the local map.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bionic faceplate
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial faceplate with toxin filtering and enhanced sensory capabilities. Nerve-gel split-links extending from the optic nerves allow the user to process visual stimuli from an array of digital eyes, granting greatly enhanced vision and night sight. This disturbing implant is most commonly seen upon members of the most brutal and savage of urbworld transhumanist gangs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: shoulder rocket pod
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a miniature rocket pod implanted on the shoulder. It can only hold a limited amount of ammo and must be reloaded with 25 chemfuel per rocket after use.

ResearchProjectDef.label: subdermal armour
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a suit of subdermally installed, lightly powered armour, formed of thin, semi-flexible plasteel plates and substituted by hyperweave where higher degrees of movement are necessary. Slim neuro-memetic assistors allow the user to move naturally.
Armour like this is often used by diplomats and undercover agents, where appearances are critical.

ResearchProjectDef.label: skeletal bracing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial, industrial skeleton affixed to the original, with responsive, motorised joints. It is designed to take a lot of the strain of carrying heavy objects off of the body, thus increasing carrying capacity.
